hero.title: وَمَنْ أَحْيَاهَا فَكَأَنَّمَا أَحْيَا النَّاسَ جَمِيعًا
hero.ayahTranslation: “And whoever saves a life, it is as though he had saved the lives of all mankind.” — Surah Al-Ma'idah (5:32)
hero.lead: A blackbox in the car detects the crash, estimates the injuries and alerts the right services — even without internet.

accelerometer.title: Accelerometer
accelerometer.desc: Measures the force of the impact and the direction it came from.

gps.title: GPS
gps.desc: Exact position and the speed just before impact.

esp32.title: ESP32
esp32.desc: The brain: reads the sensors, detects the crash, pairs with phones over Bluetooth.

gsm.title: GSM + SIM
gsm.desc: Sends the alert by data or SMS, even when the phone is broken.

lora.title: LoRaWAN
lora.desc: Long-range radio for places with no cellular signal.

antenna.title: Antenna
antenna.desc: Carries the radio signals out of the box.

chain.title: Four steps. One chain.
chain.step1Desc: The blackbox detects the impact and locates the car.
chain.step2Desc: Services, people nearby and contacts are alerted, by data or by SMS.
chain.step3Desc: AI estimates how badly people are hurt, and where.
chain.step4Desc: The patient goes to the hospital that can treat them, already prepared.

numbers.title: Trained on real crash data.
numbers.detectionDesc: Crash detection · average precision on 24,174 recordings from vehicles the model never saw.
numbers.severityDesc: Severity ranking · AUC on held-out crashes.
numbers.regionDesc: Injury regions · mean AUC across 7 body regions.
numbers.footnote: Test-set scores. Detection data comes from commercial vehicles; we plan to recalibrate on our own blackbox. These are decision-support estimates, not diagnoses.

resilience.title: When the network fails, the chain doesn't.
resilience.dataDesc: Full blackbox telemetry and high-rate sensor streams.
resilience.smsDesc: Compressed 160-char payload transmitted over weak 2G signals.
resilience.relayDesc: Mesh peer transmission to surrounding vehicles.
resilience.satDesc: Direct emergency uplink for remote desert routes.

platform.title: One platform, three views.
platform.citizenDesc: Drive mode, crash countdown, helper network alerts.
platform.responderDesc: Live map, 3D crash reconstruction, triage queue.
platform.hospitalDesc: 3D injury body map, patient profile, live vitals, ETA.

hospital.title: Hospital Dashboard
hospital.emptyDesc: No active emergency incident received. Trigger an incident from the scenario panel.
hospital.offlineBanner: Connection lost — showing last known data
hospital.newPatientDesc: Emergency blackbox transmission received for incoming crash.
hospital.m4Tooltip: Trained on US crash-investigation data; ranks regions by likelihood of serious injury.
